summary: This directory serves as the root entry point for a TypeScript library, exposing a cohesive suite of core domain models, schema definitions, utility types, and operational logic that facilitate data validation, entity management, and business process orchestration across the package.
responsibilities: Expose unified access to core domain entities and analytical schemas
Provide utility types for object manipulation and structural type safety
Centralize configuration and execution options for system-wide processes
Aggregate runtime validation contracts and domain-specific error handling mechanisms
relationships: Core domain models and schema definitions serve as the foundational types for all sub-modules.
Utility types provide necessary transformations for configuration objects and internal data structures.
The unified export strategy ensures that downstream consumers access a consistent and type-safe interface for all domain operations.
designDecisions: Centralized entry point via an index file to simplify consumer access
Co-location of type-level utilities with domain-specific schemas
Standardized naming and export patterns for architectural consistency
Separation of public-facing API surfaces from internal implementation details
